Name: Tehinnah
Summary: Son of Eshton, called the father of Ir-nahash.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:12: Son of Eshton, called the father of Ir-nahash.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Tehinnah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
